comments.body:
If there is a time I’d like to quickly discuss potential Engine/JSON-RPC API change related to the block confirmation rule:
* propagate `confirmedBlockHash` alongside to `safeBlockHash` in the `engine_forkchoiceUpdated` call
* add “confirmed” block tag to JSON-RPC

Discussion points:
* should `confirmed` block be propagated to and exposed by EL client. Alternatively, its hash could be obtained from CL client and then all EL data can be queried with that hash
* should `confirmed` block be configurable in EL client, i.e. a node operator can alias `confirmed` to `justified` or `finalized` or `confirmed`
* should we introduce `justified` block tag and preserve `safe` as an alias to the `justified`
Toni wants to go over [EIP-7623](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7623) this week
I'd like to discuss [EIP-7639: Cease serving history before PoS](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/8266)

I've quickly summarized "EIP-7623: Increasing Calldata Cost" in this doc:
https://notes.ethereum.org/@CltIPunwRmGbVfrXp0YZQg/BJRooVJ2p
I won’t be able to make this call, but just a quick shoutout about the light clients breakout call would be great! We will discuss Etan’s proposals and future needs of this part of the ecosystem.
any chance to touch on https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-2537 ?

@asanso EIP 2537 is currently "Included" in the Pectra meta EIP -- https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7600

Happy to discuss anything else you want though

if EIPs for prague CFI are being discussed again, i'd like to see if there is any progress on consensus for EIPS 5920 (PAY) and 7609 (transient storage pricing), as there was some discussion last ACDE but no conclusion was reached.
Closed in favor of https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/976 --- thanks for hosting @djrtwo!
